name: ETL Flipkart Ads data to Google BigQuery
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select **Flipkart Ads** as the data source.
2.  Select your added BigQuery data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your **Flipkart Ads** account using the **(+)** icon with your **Username & Password.** You will need to provide the Organization ID & Team ID as well while configuring the data pipelines. Their details can be found [here](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/flipkart-ads/pipelines/pla-search-term-report.html#_data_pipelines_details).
4.  Click on [+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/flipkart-ads/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
